title: Blush Framework icon pack manifest
description: An icon pack's icons.json: its name, label, namespace, and the folder its SVG icons are in.

$schema.description: The JSON Schema editors check this file with.

name.description: The icon pack's name, the key it's known by: vendor/name, such as "acme/gallery". For a Composer package, its package name.

label.description: The icon pack's title, as people read it.

namespace.description: The namespace the icon pack's components, icons, and translations go by, such as "gallery" for gallery/slideshow. No two installed extensions may share one.

folder.description: The folder inside the pack its *.svg files are in, such as "svg". Defaults to the pack's own folder. Each {icon}.svg is {namespace}/{icon}.
